@everyone Meeting Recap, Wednesday, September 9th:

Introduction to Astrophysics Club plus a lesson on NASA's newly launched Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, covering how it finds exoplanets through gravitational microlensing and how it will map dark energy.

Slide Deck: https://fhsastrophysics.github.io/fhs-astrophysics/#meeting-2627-1

Lecture Notes: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1e6RJlMtp8RqtBKpdZHJJvO1A9ltWFTJn/preview

NEXT MEETING: Wednesday, September 23rd in the Fair Oaks Room, featuring guest speaker Dr. Seth Shostak, Senior Astronomer at the SETI Institute! Don't miss out!

Attendance Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1D2yBE3Y6qXynR2xiXA-NSWX39a_ScJDkyZQOwdk-cmk/viewform

Have a great week everybody we hope to see you soon!
